name: Calendar
description: One calendar over everything: entries from all modules (lists with dates, AAC's plans) and your Home Assistant calendars (Google, CalDAV, Local Calendar, …).

read.title: Home Assistant calendars AAC reads
read.help: Every calendar integration in HA (Google, CalDAV, Local Calendar, …) appears here.

setup.title: Connect a calendar
setup.hint: Add a calendar in Home Assistant (Google Calendar, CalDAV/Nextcloud, or HA's own Local Calendar); AAC then shows it in its agenda and can put appointments there.
